thread:
maria: quick sync — SRE saw a bunch of noisy alerts after the canary. They think our rollout metadata ambiguity is to blame: 'anchor' shows up in logs but routing uses 'affinity'. Do we unify telemetry or keep both? Also TTL semantics unclear. Ping @ben @alex
ben: saw those alerts. My take: keep both fields for backward compatibility but emit a canonical mapping field so dashboards and alerts are consistent
alex: +1 on a canonical field. propose `binding_type` enum with values [hard, soft, affinity]. then `binding_origin` to indicate source (control-plane, tenant, admin, legacy-anchor).
maria: migration window? we need to avoid duplicate signal spikes in alerts
kai: translate legacy `anchor` -> `binding_type:hard` in control plane for 30d, emit deprecation metric `rollout.metadata.legacy_anchor.used` and a one-time audit report. runtime should use a deterministic fallback: exact pin -> binding -> affinity -> default. document this order
ben: also request TTL visibility: traces should include `ttl_remaining` so ops can correlate evictions to errors
maria: sample telemetry proto we'd emit in traces and logs:
```json
{"model_id":"m-abc123", "binding_type":"soft", "binding_origin":"tenant-override", "ttl_seconds":86400, "ttl_remaining":43200, "resolved_variant":"v2-small"}
```
alex: small ask: follow snake_case for telemetry (matches existing metrics). Also include a short `resolve_path` array in traces for debugging (e.g., ["pin","binding","affinity","fallback"])
ben: runtime TODOs: 1) add header `x-resolve-path` to responses, 2) include `ttl_remaining` in trace span, 3) emit event when binding flips between resolutions (so we can catch oscillations)
maria: concerned about cardinality if we add `binding_origin` with tenant ids in logs. analytics will hate us
kai: propose sampling defaults: 1% sampling for tenant_id in logs, full logging for tenants marked enterprise. For rollups/metrics, aggregate by `binding_type` only. Also add a deduped daily audit index that lists tenants using legacy anchor
alex: do Dedicated/Private deployments need special cases? pin semantics identical but admins in private deployments can insert `binding_origin:admin` which should have higher precedence than tenant overrides
maria: ok. action items: @ben to draft control-plane translation rules and migration timeline; @alex to write telemetry proto and examples; @kai to add sampling defaults and dashboard sketches. We'll run a 30d translation window and emit deprecation alerts. anyone object?
ben: no objections. I'll open a repo PR with mapping tests and a small end-to-end harness
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for binding-mapping v1 -> ok
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
